package.name: realsense_elevation_mapper
package.description: Local elevation mapping ROS2 node (C++). Subscribes to a RealSense PointCloud2 topic, accumulates the last k frames into a target frame, and publishes both the accumulated cloud and a 2D elevation grid as PointCloud2 topics for RViz visualization. Migrated from Python to C++ to keep headroom for onboard deployment and the upcoming PCL/Eigen-heavy features (normal estimation, foothold scoring, ...).
